what: Label (data-cursor="View work") — when the cursor is over a panel with this attached, a small tag (stage-color panel · 2rem high) turns on at the cursor’s bottom right with .7s expoOut and follows the mouse late with .6s expoOut. The system cursor stays as it is, and leaving the panel turns the tag off with the same curve

options.lag: Follow duration (seconds), default .6 — with 0 there is no delay and it is placed straight at the cursor position with left and top (Brand)
options.--fx-tag-bg · --fx-tag-ink: Tag plate and text color, default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.x: How many % of its own width the tag is offset to the right of the cursor, default 25 (css) — Studio 6
options.y: How many % of its own height the tag is offset downward from the cursor, default 50 (css) — Studio 40
options.flip: If true, near the right edge of the screen (within tag width + 16px) the tag flips to the left of the cursor (-100%), and in the bottom 10% of the screen it flips above the cursor (-120%), along the same curve
options.--fx-fade-ease: On/off curve (via style), default cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1) — brand ease
options.dx · dy: Distance in px to offset from the cursor (right and down are +), default 0 — Brand 5 · −16 (x: 0; with y: 0)
options.follow: With css, transform is written directly at the mouse position and a CSS transition (lag seconds · ease as cubic-bezier) delays it — the original worksStalker method. Default is GSAP quickTo
options.track: With zone, it does not follow while off (stops outside the panel), and when it turns on it jumps straight to the cursor position and then follows — like the reference site. By default it always follows even while off

note: The tag sits offset to the lower right of the cursor dot by 25% of its own width and 50% of its own height. Not created on touch devices
